section.div: A secure multi-client TCP chat server in Java featuring SSL/TLS encryption, BCrypt authentication, role-based permissions, an event-driven architecture, custom command framework, private groups, and support for CSV, JSON, and MySQL storage backends.

Larv is a Java-based interpreted scripting language built with simplicity and flexibility in mind. It is designed as a clean and lightweight language powered by a custom interpreter. More than just a tool, Larv reflects an exploration of language design and interpreter development, focusing on clear structure and ease of use.
🛒 A full-featured e-commerce REST API built with Spring Boot, Spring Security & JWT. Features product management, cart, orders, payments, and an admin panel. Documented with Swagger UI.

A lightweight and extensible Java library that maps Lua tables directly into Java objects using reflection and a strategy-based parsing system. It supports nested objects, lists, maps, and primitive types, making Lua a powerful configuration format for Java applications.
